sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# New hypothesis: maybe I need to clear exactly 7 green blocks, then move LEFT
# Get current green block positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Current green blocks: {len(greens)}")

green_centers = []
for g in greens:
    b = g['boundary']
    minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
    maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
    minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
    maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_r = (minr + maxr) // 2
    center_c = (minc + maxc) // 2
    green_centers.append((center_r, center_c))

green_centers.sort()

# Click 7 green blocks, then move LEFT
click_actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in green_centers[:7]]
click_actions.append({'action': 'LEFT'})

action(click_actions)

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nAfter 7 clicks + LEFT:")
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens2)}")
print(f"gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
print(f"level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
print(f"stopped_early={last_action_result.get('stopped_early')}")
if last_action_result.get('stopped_early'):
    print(f"stop_reason={last_action_result.get('stop_reason')}")
    print(f"executed_count={last_action_result.get('executed_count')}")
